label: Thu 19 Nov, 17:30
changes: Sign-in fixed: if you played as a guest on a device, you can now sign in to an account you already have. Before, this was refused, which locked people out on a second device.
Email sign-in now sends a 6-digit code that you type into the app. It works on any device, also when you read the email on your phone and play on your laptop.
test: On your laptop: Profile → Use email instead → your Gmail address → Send code, then type the code from the email.
Play a round as a guest on another device, then sign in there with the same email: you should land in your account with your username.
Type a wrong code: you get a clear message and can ask for a new one.
